learning.title: A pool-wide open-transaction watch only proves "no provider read in a transaction" for one call at a time
learning.trigger: A test checks that a reader or other provider call never happens while a database transaction is open, by counting the begin and commit statements of a wrapped pool.
learning.mistake: Run under Promise.all, the watch counts every concurrent admission's transaction, so one call's provider read sees another call's open transaction and the assertion fails for a correct implementation.
learning.rule: Assert the property in a sequential run (one call at a time, each origin in turn) and require that the watch saw its transaction open; keep the concurrent test for convergence only.

verification.requirement: The sequential test fails when the prefetch is moved inside withPgTransaction, and the concurrent test does not assert on the watch.
